test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 30 May 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Which of the following numbers will replace the question mark (?) in the given series?

3, 3, 12, 108, ?
solution:
Given series: 3, 3, 12, 108, ?

The pattern here is:

3 ×1² xrightarrow[]{}3\ 3 ×2² xrightarrow[]{}12\ 12 ×3² xrightarrow[]{}108\ 108 ×4² xrightarrow[]{}1728

Hence, **"****1728"** is the correct answer.
